{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline in ng/mL
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Step 4: Print only the numeric value of the mean, no formatting, no extra text
print(mean_baseline)"}
